description: This PHP class 'ValidationUniqueAPI' handles REST API requests for validating the uniqueness of entity attribute values within the system. It provides an endpoint to check whether a given value is unique for specified entities, supporting parameters like entity name, attribute name, entity ID, and matching criteria. The class utilizes Data Access Objects to perform database checks and includes detailed validation rules for request parameters.

classes.name: ValidationUniqueAPI
classes.description: A REST API endpoint class for validating the uniqueness of specific entity attribute values in OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to verify if a given value is unique for a specified entity and attribute, using DAO checks.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the GET request parameters, ensuring correct types and constraints.

methods.name: getAttributeNameRuleArray
methods.description: Retrieves valid attribute names for the specified entity for validation purposes.

methods.name: getMatchByFieldRuleArray
methods.description: Retrieves valid match-by fields for the specified entity for validation purposes.

methods.name: getValidationUniqueDao
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the DAO object used for database interaction to check value uniqueness.
